people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

translations.web: but Baruch the son of Neriah has turned you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death, and carry us away captive to Babylon.”
translations.bsb: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to deliver us into the hands of the Chaldeans, so that they may put us to death or exile us to Babylon!”
translations.kjv: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
translations.asv: but Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death, and carry us away captive to Babylon.
